summary.intent: Execute Phase 34 (E2E Test Expansion & Staging Baselines) — create account cleanup helpers, media/streaming tests, batch download tests, and capture staging performance baselines including load test data.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans executed and verified (13/13 must-haves passed), but the session ended in a disputed state: the phase was prematurely marked complete before meaningful 200-client load test baselines were captured. A 34.1 insertion was created then reverted. The 200-client load test was re-run solo (after diagnosing that simultaneous test runs caused the original 429 failures) but results weren't saved before the session ended.

repo: Staging Web3Auth init takes ~22.7s — the wallet button timeout must be at least 45s for staging runs (was 20s, causing test failures)
playwright.config.ts BASE_URL env var wasn't being used — config needed explicit `process.env.BASE_URL` override to target staging instead of localhost
cleanup-helpers.ts deleteAccountViaPage calls a hardcoded localhost:3000 URL — needs to derive API URL from the page's current URL for staging runs
vitest does NOT auto-load .env files — must source them via shell before running tests (e.g., `set -a && source .env && set +a && vitest run`)

The THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET mechanism works correctly end-to-end (verified via curl and Node.js) — 429s during load tests were caused by running two test suites simultaneously against the same staging instance, not a bypass bug
Load test client pool uses batched account creation (5 at a time) — running two suites concurrently saturates the staging API even with bypass header
BYO (Pinata) load tests use default endpoint https://api.pinata.cloud — PinataProvider sends Authorization: Bearer <token>

code.finding: walletButton.waitFor timeout was 20_000ms — too short for staging Web3Auth init (~22.7s), increased to 45_000ms
Added BASE_URL env var support and conditional webServer startup — skips local dev server when BASE_URL points to staging
Fixed API URL detection to derive from page.url() rather than hardcoded localhost:3000
No dotenv loading — must source .env via shell before running vitest, or use envFile config option
Guard logic is correct — reads X-Throttle-Bypass header and skips throttling when it matches THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET

workflow: GSD worktree agents commit on their own branches — cherry-pick to phase branch manually after completion, watching for STATE.md conflicts
When two background load tests run simultaneously against the same staging instance they interfere even with throttle bypass — run load tests sequentially
Verify staging availability before running E2E tests (curl health endpoint), and check that Web3Auth has fully initialized before asserting on wallet button
The classifyHandoffIfNeeded Claude Code bug can make agents report 'failed' despite completing all work — spot-check SUMMARY.md and git log before treating as real failure
Don't mark a phase complete in ROADMAP/STATE until all blocking acceptance criteria (like load test baselines) are captured
